metrics.world_scoring: Every comparison above uses the fixed right-world truth. Left natural endpoints are explicit counterfactual scores for changed A/C, never a claimed own-world baseline failure. Calibration uses each endpoint's own-world truth.
metrics.NLL_interpretation: Positive differences mean greater preservation-answer loss. Mixed caches can be incompatible; mediator effects do not prove semantic destruction or shared-controller necessity.
metrics.sampling: Discovery and replica remain separate. Four value siblings share a base stream; no independent-readout confidence interval is asserted.
